Overview

Penza is a city in Penza Oblast with a population of 520,000. A city on the Sura River, a cultural and industrial center with a well-preserved 19th-century city center and a growing IT sector. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 4b growing zone supports Cold — cool-season crops, hardy perennials. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher.
